toc.title: AET New York Credential Evaluation Services

html:
New York foreign credential evaluation is a must for many people who are looking to either work, immigration, or study in the United States. At AET, our credential evaluation services in New York NY cover educational as well as professional evaluations, helping make your transition to the U.S. as smooth as possible. We have a team of professionals who are experts in foreign credential evaluation in New York NY, and we are passionate about delivering 100 percent customer satisfaction.

AET New York Credential Evaluation Services

Here is a brief overview of the types of New York foreign credential evaluation we provide.

  • Document evaluation – Our credential evaluation services in New York NY provide the U.S. equivalent for credentials such as diplomas, degrees, educational certificates, transcripts and more. Your document will include a description of the program, a profile of your educational institution, its accreditation status and more. Document evaluations are typically used for not only educational purposes, but immigration and employment matters as well.
  • Course-by-course evaluation – This aspect of foreign credential evaluation in New York NY includes a list of subjects studied, grade point average information, years of attendance and institution location, program descriptions, and more. This is typically needed when someone wishes to come to the U.S. from a foreign country in order to continue their education.
  • Education and work experience – If you need a document confirming your foreign work experience in order to find a job in the U.S., we can help.

Contact AET for More Information

At AET, we can, in some instances, provide New York foreign credential evaluation on a rush basis. In other instances, rush services are not available. If you would like to learn more about our New York credential evaluation services, such as pricing, turnaround times or other information, use our convenient online form or give us a call as soon as you can.
